objective.label: Hold Mamayev Kurgan and the central landing for 5:00.

battlefield.note: A strip of ruined city along the west bank of the Volga, from the Tractor Factory past Mamayev Kurgan to the Tsaritsa gorge, with the steppe to the west and the east bank across the river.

popup.title: Stalingrad: The Volga Bank
popup.body:
You command the 62nd Army in the ruins of Stalingrad with the Volga at your back. The Sixth Army will throw division after division at Mamayev Kurgan, the hill that looks down on the whole river bank, and at the central landing, where every reinforcement comes across. Fight for each block: the rubble shelters the defender. The gunboats on the river can reach the streets near the bank.

Objective: Hold Mamayev Kurgan and the central landing for 5:00.

From September 1942 the German Sixth Army fought its way into Stalingrad and pushed the 62nd Army back to a strip of the Volga bank, but never took the whole city. On 19 November the Soviet counter-offensive, Operation Uranus, broke through on both sides of the city and encircled the Sixth Army, which surrendered in February 1943.

popup.title: Paulus attacks
popup.body: The Sixth Army is storming into the city, and its first blow is falling on Mamayev Kurgan. Hold the hill and the landing.

popup.title: The 13th Guards cross the Volga
popup.body: General Rodimtsev's 13th Guards Rifle Division has crossed the river under fire and is coming up from the central landing.

popup.title: Drive on the landing
popup.body: German armour and infantry are pushing along the Tsaritsa gorge toward the central landing. If it falls, nothing more can cross.

popup.title: The factory district
popup.body: Fresh German divisions are attacking from the north, past the Tractor Factory, toward Mamayev Kurgan.

popup.title: Operation Uranus
popup.body: Far out on the steppe the Soviet fronts have broken through on both sides of the city, and the Sixth Army is being encircled. Hold on through its last attacks.
